result.summary: Adds wallet support for sending to BIP 352 Silent Payment addresses. It implements Silent Payment destination types, adapts coin selection to require eligible inputs for shared secret derivation, dynamically generates Taproot output scripts during transaction creation, and persists original recipients in the wallet database so outputs can be recomputed during fee bumping.
result.problem: Bitcoin Core cannot send funds to BIP 352 Silent Payment addresses, preventing wallet users from paying recipients who use silent payments for receiver privacy.
evidence: PR description: 'This PR is part of integrating silent payments into Bitcoin Core. It is the second iteration of #28201. Status and tracking for the project is managed in #28536'
Commit d7f1998fa5: Adds bip352 wrapper module to common for RPCs, wallet sending/receiving/spending, and node indexes
result.scope_notes: A significant portion of the diff size (+5729 lines) comes from the BIP 352 test vector JSON file (src/test/data/bip352_send_and_receive_vectors.json). The core changes touch wallet coin selection, transaction building, fee bumping (RBF), and wallet database schema.
result.card: Adds wallet support for sending to BIP 352 Silent Payment destinations. Currently, Bitcoin Core users cannot pay Silent Payment addresses, blocking adoption of the receiver-privacy protocol. The change updates address handling, coin selection, transaction creation, and fee-bumping output recomputation. It is part of the project tracked in issue #28536 and depends on base implementation PR #35301.
